meta.promptText: Which sarees should I buy online in India for a wedding on a budget?

response.text:
If you want a **wedding-appropriate saree without spending much**, I’d focus on **Banarasi-style art silk, Banarasi georgette, and organza with zari**. At around ₹1,000–₹2,000, these tend to give a much richer festive appearance than very plain polyester. Current budget guides also put georgette, silk-blends and Banarasi-print sarees among the strongest options in this range. [barkhaboutique.com](https://barkhaboutique.com/guides/best-sarees-under-2000?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[sareeskafe.com](https://sareeskafe.com/wedding-sarees-a-complete-modern-guide-for-brides-families-guests-2/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [Organza Silk Banarasi Wedding Saree]()

### [SHOPYA Party Fancy Banarasi Saree]()

### [MANNAT MAkers Banarasi Saree]()

### [Banarasi Georgette Saree]()
*₹1,000*

### [Banarasi Organza Silk Saree]()
*₹1,999*

### [iZibra Banarasi Sari]()
*₹1,359*

### My picks by budget

- **₹700–₹1,000:** Go for a **Banarasi art-silk saree** with a broad gold border. It looks traditional and photographs well.
- **₹1,000–₹1,500:** **Banarasi georgette** is probably the best value—lighter, easier to drape, and wedding-friendly.
- **₹1,400–₹2,000:** Choose **organza + zari** if you want a more elegant, contemporary look. Current listings include organza options around ₹1,399–₹1,999. [magicdrop.in](https://magicdrop.in/drops/banarasi-organza-sarees?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Under ₹2,000:** A **shimmer georgette with zari/embellished border** is another good evening-wedding option; current examples are around ₹1,350–₹2,000. [flynker.com](https://flynker.com/blogs/news/10-best-georgette-sarees-under-2000-online-in-india-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Colours I'd choose

For a wedding guest, I'd prioritize:
**wine/maroon, emerald green, royal blue, rani pink, magenta, plum, or teal** with gold zari.

If it's a **day wedding**, try pastel pink, peach, lavender, powder blue or mint with a gold border. For an **evening wedding**, deeper jewel tones will usually look more luxurious.

**One important warning:** at ₹500–₹1,000, listings may call something “Kanjivaram silk” or “pure silk” when it's actually art silk/synthetic. Check the **fabric composition, customer photos, reviews, blouse-piece details and return policy** rather than trusting the title. [barkhaboutique.com](https://barkhaboutique.com/guides/best-sarees-under-2000?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[sareeskafe.com](https://sareeskafe.com/wedding-sarees-a-complete-modern-guide-for-brides-families-guests-2/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me your **budget (e.g. ₹1,000 / ₹1,500 / ₹2,000 / ₹3,000)**, **age**, and whether you're the **bride, bridesmaid, sister, or guest**, I can narrow it down to 5–6 specific sarees that would suit you.
